compatibility_policy.deprecation: at least one minor release before major removal

artifact.name: Artifact
artifact.strategy: v1 remains readable; v2 adds stable identity/provenance metadata

backup_manifest.name: BackupManifest
backup_manifest.strategy: archive manifest is hash/size verified before restore; unknown versions fail closed

budget_evidence.name: BudgetEvidence
budget_evidence.strategy: policy evidence is interpreted only under the recorded schema

cancellation_view.name: CancellationView
cancellation_view.strategy: derived read-only view; never alters historical TaskState hashes

context_influence.name: ContextInfluence
context_influence.strategy: frozen selected-context provenance; unknown selector contracts fail closed

exploration_state.name: ExplorationState
exploration_state.strategy: non-authoritative durable sessions; no rewrite or automatic replay on read

exploration_transition.name: ExplorationTransition
exploration_transition.strategy: exact source revision and decision bound into intake and Start gate

exploration_turn.name: ExplorationTurn
exploration_turn.strategy: immutable hash-verified reasoning evidence, never project authority

human_gate.name: HumanGate
human_gate.strategy: read-compatible; terminal gate history is never replayed

job.name: Job
job.strategy: v1 ask/run remains readable; v2 adds exploration queue actions

maintenance_event.name: MaintenanceEvent
maintenance_event.strategy: restore/cleanup provenance is append-only JSON-lines audit evidence

maintenance_intent.name: MaintenanceIntent
maintenance_intent.strategy: durable incomplete operation; read-only inspection never repairs or replays

project_learning_candidate.name: ProjectLearningCandidate
project_learning_candidate.strategy: v1 manual proposals remain readable; v2 adds typed evidence/support/provenance

provider_provenance.name: ProviderProvenance
provider_provenance.strategy: content-free dispatch provenance is append-only evidence

recovery_evidence.name: RecoveryEvidence
recovery_evidence.strategy: legacy v0.11 unversioned recovery JSON is read as schema v1 in memory; artifact bytes and hashes are not rewritten

request_receipt.name: RequestReceipt
request_receipt.strategy: durable request identity survives job-payload retirement

retention_plan.name: RetentionPlan
retention_plan.strategy: read-only plan digest is the exact cleanup scope; plans are never applied implicitly

runtime_event.name: RuntimeEvent
runtime_event.strategy: legacy SQLite rows are exposed through the v1 event envelope

usage_evidence.name: UsageEvidence
usage_evidence.strategy: unknown counters remain unknown; no inferred migration

policy.downgrade: use a verified matching full backup (or a complete pre-v0.15 control/runtime backup) with the matching older executable; lossy in-place downgrade is unsupported
policy.forward_compatibility: never guess semantics for unknown versions

safety_compatibility: unstable internals cannot silently change authority, persisted hashes or replay behavior

sdk.execute_returns: an instance of request.result_model; controller validates before use
sdk.plugin_authority: installed metadata is not activation; exact trusted project pin is required

stable_extension_boundaries.english_errors: prose is not a code; never parsed for permission or replay
stable_extension_boundaries.report_maps: documented report fields and operation semantics; dynamic provider/map keys are open
